finite_sheet_operator.uniqueness: D_square is unique up to overall scale among A4-equivariant zero-diagonal real symmetric sheet operators.

real_left_right_completion.note: This left-right completion satisfies the finite first-order condition; the naive H=C4 representation does not.

BKM_metric.identity: g_BKM = chi35 * I_16 on Hom(4_3,4_5) at rho*=aI4 direct_sum bI4
BKM_metric.consequence: the same local information metric measures geometry and gauge transfer directions before symmetry/projector refinement.

one_action_candidate.superconnection: A_total = d_base + delta_square + X, with delta_square=[D_square,.] and X=e+A
one_action_candidate.bosonic_functional: S_bos = Tr h(|D_X|/Lambda) or, at quadratic finite level, ||F_total||^2_BKM
one_action_candidate.KMS_moments: f0=ln2, f2=9 zeta(3)/4, f4=225 zeta(5)/8 if the retained fermionic KMS cutoff is adopted
one_action_candidate.status: candidate physical action; finite differential carrier and metric identities are exact, but deriving the nonlinear continuum EH coefficient and interacting gauge continuum limit remains open.
